description: Constrained delegation: principal can request tickets to a target service on behalf of any user (with protocol transition).

telemetry.detail: TGS request(s) from the S4U2proxy exchange - watch for a single principal requesting tickets for many users/services.
S4U abuse produces distinctive Kerberos patterns (S4U2self then S4U2proxy); MDI models this.

prerequisite_privilege: msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo set on the controlled account; TGT of that account
abuse_primitive: Rubeus s4u /impersonateuser to mint a service ticket as any user.
notes: Kerberos-ticket noise blends with normal TGS volume unless the SOC baselines per-principal ticket diversity. Protocol transition (TRUSTED_TO_AUTH_FOR_DELEGATION) widens impact.
